text:
Thank you to everyone who has come out to support us over the course of this campaign, the dedicated volunteers, and especially to my wife, Laina, for her never-ending support.

Across all 105 counties and hundreds of stops, when I ask Kansans what is most important to them, they tell me they want a senator who will fight to ensure they have a secure border, safe towns, and a good-paying job that can support a family.

This stands in stark contrast to the candidate Chuck Schumer has poured tens of millions into this race trying to create. Adam Hamilton donated to Joe Biden and Kamala Harris and says Barack Obama inspired him to become a Democrat. He marched in protest against our police, supports clemency for criminals and amnesty for illegal aliens, and believes we should repent for eating beef and being white.

Kansas, say no to this buyout of our state. 

Today, I am humbly asking for your vote. I would be honored to return to Washington, D.C., and keep fighting for you, your traditional family values, and your freedoms. Please get out and vote!

Find your voting location here: https://t.co/dn20i5ySdu
